annotations.title: Dry-run an app request for a user

description: Dry-run one app API request in the name of a user and get the verdict (allowed or refused, and why), changing nothing: the endpoint slug, the HTTP method (or the name of a policy action, with its itemId) and optionally the column keys the body would carry. Use it to prove that a forbidden thing is refused (an agent PATCHing assignedTo, reading another agent's row) and an allowed one passes. Requires organization owner or admin.

action.description: Name of a policy action to try on itemId (needs itemId) instead of a plain method

appId.description: App id or slug (from list_apps / create_app)

bodyKeys.description: Field or column keys the request body would write

itemId.description: The row the request is about (PATCH, DELETE, single GET)

method.description: HTTP method of the request. Pass this or action

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

userId.description: The app user the request is made as (from list_app_users)

name: simulate_request
